text:
Kai (PM): quick thread — customers say the compare table feels dense but they miss key indicators (p50, p99, cost) at a glance. do we prioritize density or add ephemeral affordances?

Sofia (Design): idea: compact rows by default, show metric chips on hover/focus. persistent compact keeps scan fast; hover reveals cost/p50/p99 in a small tooltip strip. need hover->keyboard parity. :point_up:

Ben (Frontend): hover strip ok, but tooltips can be flaky on mobile. implement both: hover for desktop, tap-to-reveal on touch. ensure we lazy-render the strip and keep DOM light. sample: role="button" on row to toggle strip for keyboard users.

Marta (A11y): must expose the strip via keyboard and announce when it opens: "Metrics for <model> expanded" via aria-live. tooltips alone are inaccessible — use focusable popover with aria-describedby. contrast for chips >=4.5.

Sofia (Design): alternate: a tiny persistent chevron that opens a short inline panel. it's discoverable and consistent across input modes. will mock chevron-first and hover-first variants.

Kai (PM): ok decide-for-prototype: compact rows + chevron reveal inline strip, tap toggles on mobile, keyboard Enter/Space toggles, aria-expanded and aria-controls used. ux-research-bot: run 5 quick sessions with power-users once in dev.

ux-research-bot: scheduled 5 guerrilla sessions for next Tue, focused on scanning speed and discoverability.

Ben (Frontend): i'll implement behind flag: compact + chevron panel, lazy content, reduced-motion respected. will add tests for focus order.

Marta (A11y): checklist before merge: tabbable control, aria-expanded, live region announce, contrast checks, mobile tap semantics. i'll sign off on PR review.

Sofia (Design): i'll upload two mocks (chevron + hover), include microcopy for chevron: "Show metrics" and delta chip tooltip copy.

Kai (PM): thanks — aim for dev deploy in next sprint. short term we keep the comfortable density in org-wide theme until rollout flag tested. :rocket:
